name: Acids, Bases and Salts
overview: On dissolving bases in water produces hydroxide (OH-) ions. Acidic and basic solutions in water conduct electricity because they produce hydrogen ions and hydroxide ions respectively. Bases which are soluble in water are called alkalis.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: On dissolving bases in _____ produces hydroxide (OH-) ions.
vsaq.answer: On dissolving bases in water produces hydroxide (OH-) ions.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: Values less than 7 on the pH scale represent an acidic _____.
vsaq.answer: Values less than 7 on the pH scale represent an acidic solution.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: In general all non- metal oxides are _____ in nature.
vsaq.answer: In general all non- metal oxides are acidic in nature.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: Universal indicator is a mixture of several _____.
vsaq.answer: Universal indicator is a mixture of several indicators.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: A compound of Calcium _____ with dilute hydrochloric acid to produce effervescence.
vsaq.answer: A compound of Calcium reacts with dilute hydrochloric acid to produce effervescence.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: The _____ of a strong base and weak acid are basic in nature and the pH value is more than 7.
vsaq.answer: The salts of a strong base and weak acid are basic in nature and the pH value is more than 7.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: Using tooth pastes, which are generally _____ neutralize the excess acid and prevent tooth decay.
vsaq.answer: Using tooth pastes, which are generally basic neutralize the excess acid and prevent tooth decay.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: Sodium carbonate and sodium _____ carbonate are useful chemicals for many industrial processes.
vsaq.answer: Sodium carbonate and sodium hydrogen carbonate are useful chemicals for many industrial processes.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: Bacteria present in the mouth produce _____ by degradation of sugar and food particles remaining in the mouth.
vsaq.answer: Bacteria present in the mouth produce acids by degradation of sugar and food particles remaining in the mouth.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: Tooth decay starts when the pH of the _____ is lower than 5.5.
vsaq.answer: Tooth decay starts when the pH of the mouth is lower than 5.5.
